levels.surface: عفان بن مسلم الصفار أبو عثمان

notes: «أنه حدثته جدتاه» names the grandmothers only after the verb: the two named women are the links, and they stand as one co-transmitter level
the aside «وكانتا، ربيبتيها وقيلة جدة أبيهما» is a gloss on kinship and is left out; the same Qayla then speaks («أنها قالت»), so she is one link
the man who comes («حتى جاء رجل») is in the scene only and is not a link
the compiler's remark «قال أبو عيسى» is not a chain
